newsitem.title: FINLAND: HELSINKI RECOVERS WITH NOKIA TRIMMING LOSSES.
newsitem.headline: HELSINKI RECOVERS WITH NOKIA TRIMMING LOSSES.

text.p: Shares recovered from a weak
start on Tuesday with forestries and financials leading the way
and Nokia paring early losses.
Scope was still seen for further gains, but the trend would
hinge on the performance of the U.S. market, brokers said.
The return into positive territory cane after an early
decline of about 0.7 percent in the FOX index.
Financials outperformed other issues. Merita rose 0.90
markka to 21.70, up more than four percent, in fair volume.
Nokia pared losses to trade down 2.50 markka at 423.00, but
off an intraday low of 415.00.
"We dipped a bit too far in the morning, and then there was
some buying at the lower levels," one broker said, and noted
strength in stock markets across Europe.
Forestries joined the recovery, recouping some of Monday's
sharp losses. UPM-Kymmene rose 1.70 markka to 131.70, while
Enso put on 0.50 to 48.00.
Raisio traded flat at 610.00 in fair trade.
Brokers said continuation of the good tone would depend on
U.S. mood ahead of and reactions to a key speech by Federal
Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan due at 2100/1800 GMT.
